comment: Single source of truth for which sources run, in what order, with what timeouts. Add/remove entries here without code edits to orchestrate.js.

sources.name: jobs.ch
sources.notes: Listing cards short — must fetch detail pages for German detection. JSON-LD available on detail.

sources.name: itjobs.ch
sources.notes: Card text ≥200 chars usually; skip enrichment. German abbreviations Tg/Std on dates.

sources.name: jobwinner.ch
sources.notes: SPA — needs JS rendering. Date badge unreliable in v1 (hard-coded to Today) — keep v1 behaviour for now, document as known issue.

sources.name: linkedin
sources.notes: Playwright only (anti-bot wall). 6 keywords serial — v2 keeps same pattern (LinkedIn nav never settles so parallelism doesn't help).

sources.name: jobscout24.ch
sources.notes: Listing via web_fetch; detail pages via raw HTTP in 10-batch. JSON-LD on detail.

sources.name: ictcareer.ch
sources.notes: Detail pages blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile under headless. Listing-only. Document the limitation in scrape log.

sources.name: jobup.ch
sources.notes: 5 pages × 20 postings. Inline JSON-LD on listing page. Teaser only — German detection will be limited (documented).
